title: A Little Life
author: Hanya Yanagihara
summary: Four friends move to New York after college and build careers over several decades. The novel gradually narrows to one of them, Jude, whose past he refuses to discuss.
readIf: you want a long, immersive, devastating novel about friendship and trauma, and are prepared for it.
skipIf: you are sensitive to graphic abuse and self-harm; it is relentless and very distressing.

pairings.reason: A long, absorbing novel of a damaged man and his friendships, with a lighter touch.
Another novel about deep friendship across decades, warmer and more playful.
